title: Pi's default active tool set includes bash, edit and write
statement: On pi 0.84.4, a session started with no explicit tool allowlist has read, bash, edit and write active alongside any custom tools, while grep, find, ls and powershell are configured but inactive. An explicit `--tools` list narrows the active set to exactly the named tools, and a tool absent from that list is not offered to the model at all.
